name: Evaluator Fabric — Strict RFC 9162 Inclusion Verification
problem: The legacy v0.6 inclusion verifier checks that a declared leaf index is in range but does not derive proof orientation/geometry from that index and tree size, permitting position relabeling of otherwise valid proofs.
hypothesis: Deriving every proof fold and exact path length from RFC 9162 leaf_index/tree_size semantics closes index relabeling and proof-geometry ambiguity while composing cleanly with v0.7 compact consistency and witness evidence.
beneficiaries: future versioned Manifest Trust -> Collision Adapter backend
authority_exclusions: No claim that cryptographic inclusion proves semantic truth

dependencies.name: Evaluator Fabric v0.7
dependencies.role: compact consistency + signed witness transition dependency

dependencies.name: RFC 9162 §2.1.1/§2.1.3.2
dependencies.role: normative Merkle hash and inclusion verification contract

interfaces.name: verify_transparency_evidence
invariants: malformed evidence does not escape exception boundary

evidence.clean_package_verification: Performed only after final ZIP creation; authoritative result and SHA-256 are recorded in external ASCENSION_STATE_CAPSULE_v019.md. Package bytes are not mutated afterward.

evaluation_vector.correctness: stronger local evidence for index/geometry binding
evaluation_vector.reproducibility: strong local deterministic and property evidence; exact-ZIP verification required
evaluation_vector.transferability: blocked: no authoritative signed real sibling manifest
evaluation_vector.integration_cost: low-to-moderate; pure read-only functions but Adapter v0.3 is not silently upgraded
evaluation_vector.observability: deterministic reason codes + expected/actual proof node count + computed root
evaluation_vector.non_interference: strong local evidence: pure/read-only; malformed evidence fails closed

failure_modes: cryptographic inclusion does not prove semantic truth
Adapter v0.3 is not upgraded in this package
real authenticated sibling Transfer remains absent

rollback.method: Use Evaluator Fabric v0.7; retain v0.6 inclusion/full-history baseline and Adapter v0.3 unchanged.

revalidation_conditions: real authenticated sibling manifest becomes available
next_experiment: If no real signed sibling manifest is available, build a versioned Adapter v0.4 backend contract that optionally pins Evaluator Fabric v0.8 strict inclusion without mutating Adapter v0.3.
